extraction.Name: Joe St John
extraction.Cancelled: I would reconmend that he have his patent cancelled
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: took out a mtg on this land for $100 dollars
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he got this mtg of $100.00 to pay up the taxes on this allotment; taxes are sky high in this part of the county and it is only a matter of time, that he will loose his land or be forced to sell it
extraction.Occupation/Income: good farmer and has farmed year after year, and still is willing to farm
extraction.NOTES: Document dated January 14, 1989 [likely 1929]; Joe St John tried to get his land reverted back to trust land but the mortgage clause stopped him; he still holds his land and is one of the few that kept his land; he is getting old and unable to earn as much as he used to; there has been crop failure in recent years; taxes run from $80.00 to $135.00 a year; has some small children to raise; agency writer recommends patent cancellation
